name: ainotate
description: Annotated screenshots: numbered steps, Skitch-style arrows, boxes, labels and solid redaction, placed where they cover the least content.
long_description: AInotate lets Claude answer 'where is it' and 'how do I' questions with a picture instead of a paragraph. It captures a web page, a window or any screenshot, finds the elements, draws numbered steps, arrows, boxes and labels where they cover the least content, blacks out emails, tokens and other secrets, and returns a preview so Claude checks the image before sending it. Web capture needs Chromium once: run `uvx --from 'ainotate[all]==0.1.8' playwright install chromium`, or attach to a browser you already use over CDP.
